name: Build the Pyramid!
desc:
🏜️ Welcome to Build The Pyramid! 

How to Play:
🧱 Pick up blocks and carry them to the pyramid.
🤝 Work together with everyone in the server.
⚡ Train to increase your speed and strength.
🏆 Complete pyramids to become even stronger!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
